# name=flags, one a line; the first is the base the others are held to.

pinb=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_BUFLD=1
pinbng=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_BUFLD=1 -DPEARL_AMD_GOPQ=0

pinst=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_STAMP=1
